correctness.rationale: The actual Pappus graph has 27 edges and 2597 nonempty independent faces (f-vector 18,126,438,801,756,348,90,18,2). The source gives a full 1293-pair acyclic Morse matching to one vertex and ten degree-four cells, and exhaustive 216-automorphism enumeration. Independent graph-automorphism and signed simplicial Lefschetz calculations reproduce the complete trace distribution {-2:21,-1:72,0:54,1:32,2:36,10:1}, zero character mean, and norm squared 2. Hence rational degree-four homology has two distinct irreducibles; the source and earlier detailed proof identify their dimensions 4 and 6. This is exhaustive for the specified finite graph, not a claim for all cubic Levi graphs.
residual_risks: Verification is exhaustive for one finite specified complex or group, not a theorem on all graphs or spaces.
